You believe Europe deserves its own internet. We do too. Let's make it happen.

You're ready to own your patch, find new partners, build relationships, and close deals. You don't need to be the biggest name in the room yet. You just need to want to get there. 
We'll give you the product knowledge, the playbooks, and the team. You bring the drive and the instinct to build something real. 
What You'll Do - 
Identify and approach hosters, MSPs, ISPs, and resellers across Europe - 
Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, demos, proposals, closing -

Help shape our partner program as we grow Job requirements 
Who You Are - 
2-4 years of B2B sales or business development experience -
